findings: The final answer supports only the two papers' input difference. Three other frozen requirements remain unresolved; this is not an accepted full comparison.

Actual readResults contain the 3DGStream NTC passage and Deformable implementation/training passage. Only B15/A17/B16 were model-extracted before exploration stopped. The sole joint-readiness request assessed inputs only, not all requirements.

The initial draft incorrectly describes 3DGStream as having no explicit deformation field and overinfers offline training from joint optimization. Deformable B16 is its own method, and its 30000-step stabilization statement is literal evidence, not a static-baseline fabrication.

Independent checks correctly reject unsupported negative source claims and training interpretations. Three received repairs add FPS or source-absence assertions outside their own target; none receives final repair verification before the budget stop.

The exploration guard protects 33333 normal-pool tokens in addition to the 50000 finalization reserve. After 8577 settled pre-synthesis tokens this leaves only 8090 tokens for a complete next reservation, causing early extraction stop under conservative full-envelope accounting. Do not interpret assessmentStatus=checked as every requested criterion checked.
One fixed retired development submission; original scores and independent first-five 0/5 remain unchanged.

**[1] Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction** · 全文片段

> The input to our method is a set of images of a monocular dynamic scene, together with the time label and the corresponding camera poses calibrated by SfM[37]which also produces a sparse point cloud.

claims.text: 3DGStream v4输入多视角视频流；Deformable 3D Gaussians v2输入单目动态图像、时间标签和SfM相机位姿及稀疏点云。
Deformable 3D Gaussians v2用变形场表示时间变化：输入高斯位置和当前时间t，输出δx,δr,δs；3DGStream v4无显式变形场，时间变化由逐帧训练、以上一帧3D高斯初始化实现。
3DGStream v4为逐帧在线训练；Deformable 3D Gaussians v2为整体离线，联合优化3D高斯与变形网络，约30k迭代稳定。
不能凭各自主表FPS给出同条件速度排名：证据未提供双方主表FPS的硬件、分辨率、场景和计时协议对齐；未知对齐不等于相同或不同，且训练模式与输入不同，无法判定同条件。
